answer_1.quote: Our work addresses organizing adversarial games with LLMs to defend against jailbreak attacks without model fine-tuning.
answer_1.outputs: system prompts, jailbreak prompts, defense strategies

answer_2.quote: Jailbreak Success Rate (JSR). Given a set of jailbreak prompts with harmful questions, JSR measures the percentage of successful jailbreaks where the defense LLM generates harmful answers to harmful questions.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4o as the evaluator LLM to assess the defense LLM's outputs.
